requirements: Users can only access their own user profile and must be blocked from viewing profiles of other users.
conditions: Access is granted when requesting_user_id matches requested_user_id.
Access is denied when requesting_user_id does not match requested_user_id.

tests.name: unauthorized_access_denied
tests.description: Verify that user 101 cannot access the profile of user 102.

tests.name: authorized_access_allowed
tests.description: Verify that user 101 can access their own profile.
